info.name: Email API Tests - Party-Time
info.description:
Comprehensive testing suite for Party-Time Email Service API

This collection tests all email endpoints including:
- Send operations (test emails, template emails)
- Email logs retrieval with filtering
- Email statistics and analytics
- AWS SES management (verification, quota)

Two testing modes:
1. **Local Mode** (Email-API-Local environment): Tests logs/stats without AWS SES
2. **AWS Mode** (Email-API-AWS environment): Full testing with AWS SES credentials

Prerequisites:
- Backend server running on localhost:8000
- PostgreSQL database running
- Redis running (for Celery)
- (Optional) AWS SES configured for send operations
